files.policies/cancellations.md:
# Cancelling an order

Use your private confirmation link to cancel at least 48 hours before your pickup time, or call 555-010-0000. For later requests, please call the bakery; staff must review them. An order that bought a gift card already used cannot be cancelled automatically. Cancellation restores any gift card balance spent and voids gift cards bought in that order. Orders are paid at pickup; any cash/card refund must be handled by staff separately.

judge_tasks.problem: Gift card terms say non-refundable; the refund page says refundable within 14 days
judge_tasks.pass_if: The refund page and gift card terms agree on whether gift cards can be refunded.

files.policies/refunds.md:
# Refunds and returns

If something isn't right, bring it back with your receipt within 14 days for a refund or exchange.
Unused gift cards can be refunded within 14 days of purchase.
Custom cakes and catering can't be returned once collected.
files.policies/gift_cards.md:
# Gift card terms

Gift cards can be used in the bakery and online. Gift cards expire 1 year after purchase.
Unused gift cards can be refunded within 14 days of purchase, as stated in our refund policy. Otherwise they can't be exchanged for cash, except where required by law.
Lost or stolen cards can't be replaced.

Online gift cards become usable only after staff confirms payment at pickup. Placing an order alone does not activate the credit.
